note: Run each prompt with the skill and with the previous version or no skill. Grade every assertion as pass or fail from the transcript and the resulting diff. A good assertion fails without the skill. should_trigger prompts must load this skill. should_not_trigger prompts are near misses that belong to another skill and must not load this one.

evals.prompt: Organic traffic to our Arabic pages dropped 40 percent last month. Why?
assertions: Asks which report shows the drop and separates Search Console from GA4
Checks the Search Console data anomalies page and update dates
Segments by locale with a page regex, remembering the default locale has no prefix
Considers a tracking or consent change before blaming search
Names a cause class with a confidence level and says the answer is inconclusive if data is missing
Never adds Search Console clicks to GA4 sessions

should_trigger: Organic traffic to our Arabic pages dropped 40 percent last month. Why?
Set up Search Console and GA4 properly for a multilingual site with locale prefixes.
Our German locale gets zero impressions in Search Console. Where do I start?
Clicks in Search Console and sessions in GA4 do not match. Which one is right?
How do I see performance for only the /ja pages when English has no prefix?
Impressions fell overnight on the 12th. Was it a Google update or our site?
Which Core Web Vitals report should I look at, field data or lab?
Can I see referrals from ChatGPT in our analytics?
should_not_trigger: Add product markup to the item page.
Do we show up when people ask ChatGPT for the best i18n starter?
Add a new locale with a plural message.
Why does the sitemap contain URLs that redirect?
Write a title tag for the pricing page.
Should we allow PerplexityBot in robots.txt?
